data.long_meaning: The name Gustave is derived from the Germanic elements gus (gust) meaning 'staff of God' and thau (tha) meaning 'god'. This name was popularized in Europe during the Middle Ages and was often given to children born into noble families. The name has since been adopted by various cultures and continues to be a favorite among Christians today.
